name: Shopify
summary: Shopify apps must authenticate before accessing the store’s data via the Admin API. You must use your own OAuth credentials, as Composio-managed OAuth is not available. The setup involves registering your Shopify app, configuring permissions (scopes), specifying the redirect URI, retrieving your client credentials, and entering them in Composio before connecting and authorizing with your Shopify store. Shopify apps outside the Shopify admin use the OAuth2 authorization code grant flow.
decision: Go to your Shopify Admin Dashboard to create an app and select its scopes and redirect URI, then copy your Client ID and Client Secret. In Composio, set up an OAuth2 authentication config using the credentials from Shopify and specify the same redirect URI as in your Shopify app. Connect your account, authorize the app on Shopify, and ensure the connection is active.

prerequisites.title: Shopify admin account
prerequisites.body: Sign up at shopify.com and set up your Shopify admin dashboard.

prerequisites.title: Access to Shopify App Development Dashboard
prerequisites.body: You must be able to create and manage apps from the Shopify dev dashboard.

prerequisites.title: Composio account
prerequisites.body: You need a Composio account to add an OAuth config.

steps.title: Create a Shopify app in the dev dashboard
steps.body: Log in to your Shopify admin dashboard, search for 'App Development', and enter the development dashboard.

steps.title: Configure basic app info
steps.body: Click 'Create App', enter an app name, and set the main application URL.

steps.title: Select API scopes
steps.body: Choose the required Shopify API scopes such as read_orders, write_orders, read_products, and write_products. Add others as needed, e.g., read_customers or write_inventory.

steps.title: Release app version
steps.body: Click “Release” at the bottom of the page to publish your app version.

steps.title: Copy OAuth client credentials
steps.body: Go to the app's settings and copy your Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Create Auth Config in Composio
steps.body: In Composio, create a new Auth Config, select Shopify, choose 'OAuth2', and check 'Use your own developer credentials'. Fill in your Client ID, Client Secret, and Redirect URI.

steps.title: Connect and authorize
steps.body: In Composio, click 'Connect Account', enter external user ID and Shopify store subdomain, and authorize the app when redirected to Shopify.

steps.title: Confirm successful authentication
steps.body: After authorization, close the window and ensure Composio shows your Shopify connection as 'Active'.

blockers.title: Redirect URI mismatch
blockers.body: Shopify will reject authorization if the redirect URI does not match exactly in both the app dashboard and Composio config.

blockers.title: Insufficient API scopes
blockers.body: If you do not select all required scopes, certain API calls will fail with 403 errors.

human_actions.title: Create Shopify app and configure it manually
human_actions.body: A person must create and configure the app, select scopes, set URLs, and copy credentials.

human_actions.title: Paste credentials into Composio
human_actions.body: You must manually input the Client ID and Client Secret in Composio.

human_actions.title: Authorize the app when connecting
human_actions.body: During connection, you must approve the app in Shopify to allow access.
